mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.productName,s.sellerName,b.buyerName,s.createdAt,s.`condition` FROM (select o.id AS id,p.`name` AS productName,u.username AS sellerName,o.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition` AS `condition` from lxy_order o join lxy_product p join lxy_user u where o.sell_uid=u.id and o.product_id=p.id) s JOIN (select o.id AS id,p.`name` AS productName,u.username AS buyerName,o.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition` AS `condition` from lxy_order o join lxy_product p join lxy_user u where o.buy_uid=u.id and o.product_id=p.id) b WHERE s.id=b.id

select o.id as id, p.name as productName, s.username as sellerName, b.username as buyerName, o.created_at as createdAt, o.`condition` as `condition` from lxy_order o left join lxy_product p on p.id = o.product_id left join lxy_user s on s.id = o.sell_uid left join lxy_user b on b.id = o.buy_uid where o.product_id = #{id}
